name: Clone: Clone 0 falls into the void · 4t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 4 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Clone 0: 1 cell, starting at (2, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north; Clone 0 moves 1 north.
Ticks 2–3 (each tick): Clone 0 moves 1 down.
Tick 4: Clone 0 disappears.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
